name: two-wheres-and-in-order
dql: LIST FROM "a" WHERE status = "open" WHERE due
oqx: select path from docs where (path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md") and status == "open" and due

name: where-with-or-and-not
oqx: select path from docs where (status == "open" or status == "blocked") and !archived

name: where-and-or-words
dql: LIST WHERE status = "open" and !archived or pinned
oqx: select path from docs where status == "open" and !archived or pinned

name: sort-asc-default
oqx: select path from docs order by updated_at

name: sort-descending-word
oqx: select path from docs order by updated_at desc

name: sort-multiple-keys
dql: TABLE priority, due SORT priority DESC, due ASC
oqx: select path, priority, due from docs order by priority desc, due

name: later-sort-wins-earlier-breaks-ties
dql: LIST SORT due SORT priority DESC
oqx: select path from docs order by priority desc, due

name: sort-by-derived-field-warns
oqx: select path from docs order by path
warnings: SORT file.name orders by the full path (OQX has no basename/dirname)

name: limit
oqx: select path from docs where path.startsWith("/a/") or path == "/a.md" limit 5

name: where-sort-limit
dql: TABLE file.mtime FROM "notes" WHERE file.mtime >= date(today) - dur(7 days) SORT file.mtime DESC LIMIT 20
oqx: select path, updated_at from docs where (path.startsWith("/notes/") or path == "/notes.md") and updated_at >= date("today").minus("7 days") order by updated_at desc limit 20
